method: Original closed glove anatomy is adapted from the owned clothing-glove source; separate fingers, thumbs, hollow cuffs and original armor plates/trim. Existing owned leather, steel and gold pixels are reused byte-for-byte. No image generation or raster edit.
limitations: Simplified plate, stitching, rune and back details; fixed paired pose; no worn modular fitting or author approval.
iterations: Initial finger pads looked like round studs in native front views. Replaced them with closed curved plate segments that wrap the existing fingers; other geometry and raster pixels are unchanged.
